svg.title: TinyStories 51M: training loss, validation loss and learning rate over 50,000 steps
svg.desc: 101 logged samples, every 500 iterations and the final iteration. Later resumed segment replaces overlap at iteration 38,500. Training loss is one batch; validation loss averages 20 randomly sampled batches. No wall clock times are joined.

g.text: Recorded samples only · later segment supersedes overlapping iteration 38,500
Single training batch at each logged iteration; unsmoothed
Mean of 20 random validation batches; distinct from final fixed-window evaluation
Dashed line: first logged point in resumed segment (step 38,501); no exact pause duration inferred.
